name: Biotin
aliases: Biodermatin, Bioepiderm, Bios h, Bios II, Biotina, Biotine, Biotinum, Coenzyme R
summary: Biotin (also known as vitamin B7 and vitamin H) is one of the B vitamins – a group of essential dietary micronutrients. Present in every living cell, it is involved as a cofactor for enzymes in numerous metabolic processes, both in humans and in other organisms, primarily related to the biochemistry of fats, carbohydrates, and amino acids.

uses.text: Biotin is obtained from foods, particularly meats and liver, and is sold as a dietary supplement.

zhOther: 維他命H, 維生素B7, 維生素H
summaryZh: 生物素為維生素B群之一，又稱維生素H、維生素B7、輔酶R等。

pharmacology.en: Biotin is a vitamin, not a drug. It works as a cofactor for carboxylase enzymes, which attach carbon dioxide to other molecules, a step needed in building fats and breaking down certain amino acids.
pharmacology.zh: 生物素是維生素而非藥物。它作為羧化酶的輔因子，幫助這些酵素把二氧化碳接到其他分子上，這是合成脂肪與分解某些胺基酸的必要步驟。
pharmacology.zhHans: 生物素是维生素而非药物。它作为羧化酶的辅因子，帮助这些酵素把二氧化碳接到其他分子上，这是合成脂肪与分解某些胺基酸的必要步骤。

sideEffects.en: It is a water soluble vitamin and extra amounts are passed in urine. The main practical problem is that supplements can badly distort laboratory blood tests, including thyroid and heart tests, which has led to wrong diagnoses.
sideEffects.zh: 它是水溶性維生素，多餘的部分會隨尿液排出。主要的實際問題是補充品會嚴重干擾實驗室血液檢驗，包括甲狀腺與心臟相關檢查，曾因此導致誤診。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它是水溶性维生素，多余的部分会随尿液排出。主要的实际问题是补充品会严重干扰实验室血液检验，包括甲状腺与心脏相关检查，曾因此导致误诊。

fact.en: Raw egg white contains avidin, a protein that grips biotin so tightly that eating a lot of it can cause a deficiency. Cooking the egg destroys the avidin and frees the vitamin.
fact.zh: 生蛋白含有卵白素，這種蛋白質與生物素結合得極為緊密，大量食用可能造成生物素缺乏。將蛋煮熟會破壞卵白素，使維生素得以釋出。
fact.zhHans: 生蛋白含有卵白素，这种蛋白质与生物素结合得极为紧密，大量食用可能造成生物素缺乏。将蛋煮熟会破坏卵白素，使维生素得以发布。
